ui.choose-an-input-to-capture-its-first-: Choose an input to capture its first still automatically.

ui.capture-available-again-shortly: क्याप्चर केही बेरमा फेरि उपलब्ध हुन्छ।

ui.snapshots-are-reduced-resolution-imag: Snapshots are reduced-resolution images, not a live feed. Their size depends on the device's snapshot settings.
ui.snapshots-are-disabled-for-this-input: Snapshots are disabled for this input. Enable input snapshots in WebRCS and refresh the connection.

ui.offline-choose-the-device-family-and-: Offline: choose the device family and enter its native screen/layer IDs.
ui.unmapped-excluded-from-linked-sends-a: Unmapped — excluded from linked sends and loads.
ui.scope-for-both-device-send-and-load-i: Scope for both device send and load. In Folder mode, clicking a folder in the layer list switches the scope.
ui.open-connection-settings-layer-links-: Open connection settings, layer links and send/load options.
ui.last-four-successful-connections-choo: Last four successful connections; choose one to connect
ui.address-saved-automatically-in-applic: Address saved automatically in application settings. Connect reads device data; it does not change layers.
ui.connect-to-a-device-in-connection-set: Connect to a device in Connection settings before transferring layers.
ui.send-the-mapped-editor-layers-to-the-: Send the mapped editor layers to the selected device target
ui.supported-layers-import-geometry-and-: Supported layers import geometry and appearance. Midra explicit fits include crop and mask; Aquilon supports centered crop. Source routing and shared input settings stay on the device.
ui.choose-an-existing-destination-or-new: Choose an existing destination or New layer beside each device layer. The scope limits available destinations; each mapping can still be changed.
ui.no-layers-in-this-scope-choose-all-la: यो दायरामा तह छैन। सबै तह, केही तह वा फोल्डर छान्नुहोस्।
ui.geometry-matches-the-stored-values-se: Geometry matches the stored values. Send applies them to the hardware.
ui.changing-output-preserves-layer-posit: Changing output preserves layer positions and sizes. Custom dimensions are planning sizes, not verified device modes.
ui.viewport-camera-does-not-change-layer: Viewport camera (does not change layer or crop geometry)
ui.these-dimensions-describe-the-editor-: These dimensions describe the editor source, not a device timing command. Local input correction is currently folded into exported layer crop; use the device controls above for the actual shared device input settings.
ui.editor-inputs-share-source-format-and: Editor inputs share source format and input crop between editor layers. Inputs 1–8 are offered initially; add more as needed. This local identity does not select a physical device input or change routing.
ui.custom-input-resolution-retains-the-s: Custom input resolution retains the Source format above.
ui.center-input-crop-to-this-size: Center input crop to this size
ui.input-crop-edges-native-source-pixels: Input crop edges: native source pixels. Native-size changes reset the draft input crop before review.
ui.resizing-automatically-adjusts-the-la: Resizing automatically adjusts the layer crop to fit the new dimensions.
ui.ratio-ready-enable-the-lock-to-resize: Ratio ready; enable the lock to resize.
ui.layer-size-changes-apply-as-you-edit-: सम्पादन गर्दा तहको आकार बदलिन्छ। पूर्ववत् गर्दा पुराना मान फर्किन्छन्।
ui.source-changes-require-apply-switchin: स्रोत परिवर्तनका लागि लागू गर्नुहोस् थिच्नुपर्छ। ट्याब बदल्दा बाँकी परिवर्तन रहन्छन्।
ui.the-magenta-box-reveals-pixels-everyt: The magenta box reveals pixels. Everything outside it is blanked; image scale, crop and layer bounds stay unchanged.
ui.drag-any-edge-or-corner-independently: Drag any edge or corner independently; drag inside the layer to move the window. Arrows move 1 output pixel, Shift+arrows 10. Opposite edges may meet to blank everything. Escape cancels a drag; Undo restores it.
ui.mask-proportions-follow-layer-resizin: Mask proportions follow layer resizing. Masking transparent or already cropped pixels has no visible effect.
ui.crop-first-then-fit-into-the-layer-re: Crop first, then fit into the layer rectangle. Resize changes the container; 1:1 keeps the image pixel-for-pixel.
ui.drag-helper-edges-to-trim-without-zoo: Drag helper edges to trim without zooming; drag anywhere inside the layer, including empty margins, to reposition the crop without resizing it. Arrow keys move by 1 source pixel, Shift+arrows by 10. Movement stops at the usable source edges. Double-click toggles the helper.
ui.this-mode-fits-automatically-the-canv: This mode fits automatically. The canvas crop helper is disabled; numeric crop edges remain available here.
ui.edit-crop-edges-here-visual-zoom-drag: Edit crop edges here; visual zoom/drag controls are for normal crop mode.
ui.disabling-advanced-fit-restores-norma: Disabling advanced fit restores normal cover framing. Device subpixel rendering is approximate.
ui.zoom-and-position-change-the-crop-val: Zoom and position change the crop values inside this layer, keeping its visible box fixed. 100% is the minimum crop that fills the box.
ui.crop-zoom-and-offsets-apply-as-you-ed: Crop zoom and offsets apply as you edit. Offsets stop at the content edges and adjust when zoom decreases. Undo restores earlier values.
ui.captured-stills-follow-this-layer-s-i: Captured stills follow this layer’s input and dynamic crops. Guides are drawn above the image; screen references are separate.
ui.to-stage-connect-match-this-layer-s-s: To stage: connect, match this layer's saved mapping and routed input/plug, then enable advanced input edits. Send remains a separate action.
ui.shared-input-corrections-for-this-ada: Shared input corrections for this adapter are managed in WebRCS. Layer crop and zoom remain available in the editor.
ui.advanced-use-only-when-you-need-to-co: Advanced — use only when you need to correct an input and understand the effect.
ui.these-device-controls-map-one-for-one: These device controls map one-for-one to WebRCS Advanced Input settings. Content ratio / Transform to change the input's aspect before layer framing. Usually leave them set on the Midra.
ui.input-crop-removes-source-edges-befor: Input crop removes source edges before dynamic layer crop / zoom. It does not resize the layer's bounding box. This processing is a Midra feature, not an editor-only effect.
ui.edit-advanced-input-settings-and-incl: Edit advanced input settings and include my edits when sending
ui.off-by-default-only-edited-device-fie: Off by default. Only edited device fields are sent, and only with layers using that input. Inputs are shared: edits can affect other layers and Program too. Uncheck to discard staged edits. This opt-in lasts for this session only.
ui.connect-and-map-this-layer-to-a-midra: Connect and map this layer to a Midra input source to inspect its advanced settings. No device input edits are staged offline.
ui.saving-a-proposal-is-opt-in-project-s: Saving a proposal is opt-in. Project saves and extra-parameter exports retain it; reopening never stages or sends it.
ui.edits-wait-for-send-opening-this-tab-: Edits wait for Send; opening this tab or enabling the checkbox sends nothing. Refresh/load after sending to inspect the device's resulting content dimensions.

ui.no-source-name-destination-name-stays: स्रोत नाम छैन; गन्तव्य नाम उही रहन्छ।

transfer.read-help: Read fresh Preview geometry and cropping from the device into the linked editor layers. Undo restores the previous layout.
crop.help-mask: मास्कले तस्बिर नसारी वा आकार नबदली पिक्सेल छोप्छ। म्याजेन्टा किनारा तान्नुहोस् वा तहभित्र झ्याल सार्नुहोस्।

crop.help-native: Drag edges to trim; drag anywhere inside the layer to reposition the crop. Movement preserves crop size, pixel scale and the container.
crop.help-advanced: Opens advanced crop edges and fit mode. The rectangle defines the container.
crop.help-normal: यो तहभित्र क्रप बदल्छ। सामग्री तान्नुहोस्; देखिने बक्स स्थिर रहन्छ।
language.confirm: यो नयाँ भाषा तपाईंलाई ठीक छ?
language.rollback: पुष्टि नगरेमा %{seconds} सेकेन्डमा अघिल्लो भाषा फर्किन्छ।
language.cancel: होइन, मैले झुक्किएर यो भाषा छानेँ
access.text-help: सामान्य नियन्त्रणका लागि थप स्केल। क्यानभास चित्र र निश्चित आकारका लेबलहरू इन्टरफेस स्केल पछ्याउँछन्।
mask.origin-help: तहले तहका सीमा पछ्याउँछ। स्रोतले क्रप/जुम अघिको प्रयोगयोग्य तस्बिर पछ्याउँछ। बदल्दा किनाराका प्रतिशत उही रहन्छन्।
mask.proportions-help: मास्क अनुपातले छानिएको आधार पछ्याउँछ। देखिने तहबाहिरका पिक्सेल छोप्दा असर पर्दैन।
ui.reference-picture-help: Local reference only; never sent to the device. Uses this layer’s source format, crop, zoom, fit and mask. Choose a capture input to replace it.
